title: Trader Diary: BTC hits $76.6k and my brain does a backflip
content: 📈 1% up and I'm already drafting a 10x long plan. 5 min later I'm checking the 1‑minute chart like it's a Netflix series. By 3 am I'm convinced the dip is just a “sale” and I need to buy the dip… again.
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before the hype hits; otherwise your FOMO will fund the next pizza.
question: Who else is re‑watching the 1‑minute candles at 2 am? Drop your meme faces 👇
